# Filter#createEvaluator re-reads its reactive configs for every item

## Context

`Collection#evaluateFilters()` builds one evaluator per filter with `Filter#createEvaluator()` and calls it for every item. The evaluator calls `isFiltered()`, which reads `_disabled`, `_filterBy`, `_value` (up to three times), `_property` and `_operator` on every call. Each is a reactive config accessor (`getConfig(key)?.get()`), and `Config#get()` registers an effect dependency. A scan of N items makes about 7N reactive reads per filter, although none of these values changes during a scan.

Measured on `dev` at f1cf372d68 (Node, unit tier, median of 7 `getFilteredItems()` calls on a 100k-item `Collection` with one filter). The second column swaps in a `createEvaluator()` that reads the configs once per scan:

| Filter | Now | Configs read once | Kept (both) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name like 'al'` | 45.9 ms | 4.7 ms | 21,332 |
| `city === 'c7'` | 41.6 ms | 1.1 ms | 1,985 |
| `city typedIncluded` (5 of 50 values) | 37.3 ms | 2.5 ms | 9,838 |
| `name like ''` (empty, keeps all) | 21.9 ms | 0.9 ms | 100,000 |

## The Problem

Every full filter pass pays this plumbing:

- `Collection#filter()`, the filtering writer;
- `getFilteredItems(excludeFilter)`, the observational query a value picker's live counts run once per excluded filter;
- `TreeStore#filter()`, which calls `isFiltered()` per node directly.

At grid scale that is 20–45 ms per filter per pass before an operator decides anything. The 13.3 header menus (#19643, roadmap row 2) filter by checked values with live counts, so they run these scans repeatedly.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/collection/Filter.mjs` `createEvaluator()`: computes the `typedIncluded` keys once, then returns `(item, filteredItems, allItems) => this.isFiltered(item, filteredItems, allItems, keys)`.
- `src/collection/Filter.mjs` `isFiltered()`: the per-item decision. Its order is disabled → keep, no item → filtered, `filterBy` → its result, empty value with `includeEmptyValues` → keep, `typedIncluded` → key lookup, two `Date`s → compared by `valueOf()`, else `!Filter[operator](recordValue, value)`.
- `src/Neo.mjs` `createConfig()`: defines `_key` as an accessor, `get() {return this.getConfig(key)?.get()}`; `src/core/Config.mjs` `get()` calls `EffectManager.addDependency(this)`.
- `src/collection/Base.mjs` `evaluateFilters()`: the only `createEvaluator()` caller.
- `src/data/TreeStore.mjs` `filter()`: `activeFilters[i].isFiltered(node)` per node, without an evaluator.
- `src/collection/SearchFilter.mjs` overrides `isFiltered()` (terms over field text), so a read-once evaluator must not bypass a subclass's `isFiltered()`.

Design authority: `Filter#createEvaluator` JSDoc, "Builds a scan-local evaluator; typed selection keys are computed once without mutating the Filter." A scan already holds the filter fixed; this extends the contract from the typed keys to every config the scan reads.

Decision Record impact: none.

## The Fix

1. `Filter#createEvaluator()`: when `isFiltered` is the base implementation, read `disabled`, `filterBy`, `scope`, `includeEmptyValues`, `value`, `property` and `operator` once and return a closure that applies `isFiltered()`'s decision order to the item alone. A subclass that overrides `isFiltered()` keeps today's delegating closure.
2. `TreeStore#filter()`: build the active filters' evaluators once and call them per node.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: For every operator in `Filter.operators`, and for `filterBy`, disabled, empty-value and `Date` filters, the evaluator returns what `isFiltered()` returns over the same value matrix (spec).
- [ ] AC-2: A `SearchFilter`'s evaluator still decides through its own `isFiltered()` (spec).
- [ ] AC-3: `TreeStore#filter()` scans through evaluators; the existing TreeStore filter specs stay green.
- [ ] AC-4: The PR body states the 100k `getFilteredItems()` medians before and after (same machine, same method); the `like` case is at least 5× faster.
- [ ] AC-5: `npm run test-unit` is green.

## Out of Scope

- Cheaper reactive reads in general (`Config#get()`, `EffectManager.addDependency()`): core-wide, with its own measurement.
- `Collection#isFilteredItem()` per spliced item: `Store` overrides it to resolve fields on raw Turbo rows, so it stays a method call.
- Work inside the operators (`like` lower-cases the filter value on every call).
- `TreeStore#filter()`'s active-filter rule (`!f.disabled && f.value !== null`), which ignores a `filterBy` filter without a value: captured as a defect-note, a separate fix.

## Avoided Traps

- Caching an evaluator on the Filter across scans: every config change would need invalidation. The evaluator stays scan-local.

## Related

- #19669 / PR #19673 introduced `createEvaluator()` and the typed keys.
- #19643: header menus whose value picker counts with `getFilteredItems()`.
